---
title: "Trap: a pipeline drawn for A4, read on a 6-inch screen"
mdbrand:
  brand: none
  style: note
---

Five boxes in a row need the page's whole measure; on an e-reader's column
their labels fall under the floor. The build warns and goes on: the column is
an assumption, and the reader can zoom the picture.

```d2 caption="Pipeline"
direction: right
Ingesta -> Limpieza -> Entrenamiento -> Validación -> Despliegue
```
